title: Abilian's own OSS products deploy self-hosted apps but none of them carries a business-event record
content:
Abilian ships its own open-source products — Abilian SBE, a CRM, and Nua, a self-hosted PaaS — built on Python and Django. Nua's concern is deployment: getting self-hosted applications running under the operator's own control.

The research's finding is that none of these products carries a business-event record. Self-hosting answers where an application runs and who administers it; the collaboration and CRM products hold current state about people and content. Missing across all three is the attributed record of what was decided within them, which is a different kind of object from either configuration or content.

Because these are Abilian's own products on a stack the firm authored, the gap is addressable as a product decision rather than as a client integration — the same pattern that appears at the other product-owning leads in the corpus. Python and Django also mean the dispatch points are ordinary framework extension points rather than a new runtime to introduce.
